  tail: **Change:** `save_report()` now writes to a temporary file first (in the same directory as the target), then atomically renames it to the target path using `os. | This makes the write crash-safe because: | - The original `report.txt` is never opened for writing until the new content is fully written to the temp file | - `os.replace()` is atomic on both Linux and Windows (when source and destination are on the same filesystem) | - A crash mid-write leaves only the temp file behind; the existing report remains intact
